title: DOJ Wins Court Authority to Seize $1.2 Billion of North Korea’s Stolen Binance Crypto as Freezes Top $2.7 Billion

title: DOJ’s Operation TorNado Arrests 354 and Seizes $234 Million in Cash and Crypto
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

DOJ’s Operation TorNado Arrests 354 and Seizes $234 Million in Cash and Crypto

The Justice Department said the sweep that ran from May 2025 to October 2026 was the sixth and most extensive JCODE action since 2018, seizing 5.7 metric tons of drugs and 209 firearms, without saying how much of the money was cryptocurrency.

This post DOJ’s Operation TorNado Arrests 354 and Seizes $234 Million in Cash and Crypto first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
